drinks.name: A. J.
drinks.instructions: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: A1
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker, mix and serve over ice into a chilled glass.

drinks.name: Abilene
drinks.instructions: Pour all of the ingredients into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.

drinks.name: Acapulco
drinks.instructions: Combine and shake all ingredients (except mint) with ice and strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes. Add the sprig of mint and serve.

drinks.name: Ace
drinks.instructions: Shake all the ingredients in a cocktail shaker and ice then strain in a cold glass.

drinks.name: Adam
drinks.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Addington
drinks.instructions: Mix both the vermouth's in a shaker and strain into a cold glass. Top up with a squirt of Soda Water.

drinks.name: Addison
drinks.instructions: Shake together all the ingredients and strain into a cold glass.

drinks.name: Affair
drinks.instructions: Pour schnapps, orange juice, and cranberry juice over ice in a highball glass. Top with club soda and serve.

drinks.name: Affinity
drinks.instructions: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Air Mail
drinks.instructions: Shake rum, lime juice and honey syrup with ice. Strain into a chilled champagne flute. Top with champagne and stir gently.

drinks.name: Algonquin
drinks.instructions: Combine and shake all ingredients with ice, strain contents into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Allegheny
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except lemon peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Top with the twist of lemon peel and serve.

drinks.name: Almeria
drinks.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Amaretto Sour
drinks.instructions: Dry shake all ingredients without ice for 5 seconds. Add ice and shake again for 15 seconds. Strain into a chilled rocks glass over fresh ice.
drinks.garnish: Cocktail cherry and 3 dashes of Angostura bitters

drinks.name: Americano
drinks.instructions: Mix the ingredients directly in an old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Add a splash of Soda Water. Stir gently.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with half orange slice and a lemon zest.

drinks.name: Angel Face
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes. Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Aperol Spritz
drinks.instructions: Build all ingredients into a wine glass filled with ice. Stir gently.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with a slice of orange.

drinks.name: Applecar
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Appletini
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Artillery
drinks.instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Aviation
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: B52
drinks.instructions: Layer ingredients one at a time starting with Kahlúa, followed by Baileys Irish Cream and top with Grand Marnier. Flame the Grand Marnier, serve while the flame is still on, accompanied with a straw on side plate.

drinks.name: Bacardi
drinks.instructions: Shake with ice cubes. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Bahama Mama
drinks.instructions:
Add 2 parts club soda or more or less to taste.

Mix it all together and pour over a bunch of ice. Drink with a straw.

drinks.name: Balmoral
drinks.instructions: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Bamboo
drinks.instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Barracuda
drinks.instructions: Pre-chill a coupe glass. Shake the first four ingredients with ice and fine-strain into the chilled glass. Top with sparkling wine.

drinks.name: Bee’s Knees
drinks.instructions: Stir honey with lemon and orange juices until it dissolves, add gin and shake with ice. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.garnish: Optionally garnish with a lemon or orange zest.

drinks.name: Bellini
drinks.instructions: Pour peach puree into the mixing glass with ice, add the Prosecco wine. Stir gently and pour in a chilled flute glass.

drinks.name: Between the Sheets
drinks.instructions: Add all ingredients into a cocktail shaker. Shake with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Bicicletta
drinks.instructions: Build Campari and white wine over ice in a large wine glass. Top with soda water.

drinks.name: Bijou
drinks.instructions: Stir in mixing glass with ice and strain

drinks.name: Black Russian
drinks.instructions: Pour the ingredients into the old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently. strain ingredients into old fashioned glass filled with ice.

drinks.name: Black Velvet
drinks.instructions: Mix equal parts stout and Champagne in a pint glass, no ice. Alternatively, layer in a champagne flute: fill halfway with sparkling wine and float chilled stout on top over the back of a spoon.

drinks.name: Blackthorn
drinks.instructions: Stir sloe gin and vermouth with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.

drinks.name: Blood and Sand
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well. Strain into a chilled coupe.
drinks.garnish: Maraschino cherry and flamed orange zest

drinks.name: Bloody Mary
drinks.instructions: Stir gently all the ingredients in a mixing glass with ice, pour into rocks glass.

drinks.name: Blue Hawaii
drinks.instructions: Combine all ingredients with ice in a shaker. Shake well, then pour into a hurricane glass with ice.
drinks.garnish: Pineapple quarter slice and maraschino cherry

drinks.name: Bluebird
drinks.instructions: In a mixing glass half-filled with crushed ice, combine the gin, triple sec, Curacao, and bitters. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the lemon twist and the cherry.

drinks.name: Boomerang
drinks.instructions: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, vermouth, bitters, and maraschino liqueur. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the cherry.

drinks.name: Bora Bora
drinks.instructions: Prepare in a blender or shaker, serve in a highball glass on the rocks. Garnish with 1 slice of pineapple and one cherry.

drinks.name: Boston Sour
drinks.instructions: Shake juice of lemon, powdered sugar, blended whiskey, and egg white with cracked ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Add the slice of lemon, top with the cherry, and serve.

drinks.name: Boulevardier
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with a orange zest, optionally a lemon zest.

drinks.name: Bourbon Smash
drinks.instructions: Gently muddle mint with simple syrup in a rocks glass. Add lemon wheels and muddle to extract juice. Fill with crushed ice, pour bourbon over, add bitters, and swizzle gently.

drinks.name: Boxcar
drinks.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass.

drinks.name: Bramble
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker except the Crème de Mûre, shake well with ice, strain into chilled old fashioned glass filled with crushed ice, then pour the blackberry liqueur (Crème de Mûre) over the top of the drink, in a circular motion.
drinks.garnish: Garnish optionally with a lemon slice and blackberries.

drinks.name: Brandy Alexander
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.garnish: Sprinkle fresh ground nutmeg on top

drinks.name: Brandy Crusta
drinks.instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice in a mixing glass until well chilled, then strain into a chilled cocktail glass with a sugar-crusted rim.
drinks.garnish: Wide lemon peel curled inside the glass

drinks.name: Breakfast Martini
drinks.instructions: Add marmalade to the shaker first and dissolve in the gin. Add remaining ingredients with ice and shake well. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Brigadier
drinks.instructions: Mix ingredients in a warmed mug and stir.

drinks.name: Broadside
drinks.instructions: Half fill the glass with ice cubes. Crush the wormwood and add to ice. Pour rum, scotch and butters, then serve!

drinks.name: Brooklyn
drinks.instructions: Combine ingredients with ice and stir until well-chilled. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Caipirinha
drinks.instructions: Place lime and sugar into a double old fashioned glass and muddle gently. Fill the glass with cracked ice and add Cachaça. Stir gently to involve ingredients.

drinks.name: Caipirissima
drinks.instructions: Place lime and sugar into a rocks glass. Muddle gently. Add the rum and stir. Fill the glass with crushed ice and add a stirrer.

drinks.name: Campari Soda
drinks.instructions: Build Campari over ice in a highball glass. Top with chilled soda water and stir gently.

drinks.name: Canchanchara
drinks.instructions: Mix honey with water and lime juice and spread the mixture on the bottom and sides of the glass. Add cracked ice, and then the rum. End by energetically stirring from bottom to top.

drinks.name: Cardinale
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Casa Blanca
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Casino
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktails shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled rocks glass with ice.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with a lemon zest and a maraschino cherry.

drinks.name: Casino Royale
drinks.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass.

drinks.name: Champagne Cocktail
drinks.instructions: Place the sugar cube with 2 dashes of bitters in a large Champagne glass, add the cognac. Pour gently chilled Champagne.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with orange zest and maraschino cherry.

drinks.name: Chartreuse Swizzle
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a tall glass, add pebble ice. With the help of a swizzle stick (or cocktail spoon) mix vigorously, complete by filling the glass with more pebble ice.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with mint leaves and grated nutmeg.

drinks.name: Cherry Rum
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Chicago Fizz
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

drinks.name: City Slicker
drinks.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Clove Cocktail
drinks.instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Clover Club
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktails shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Corn n Oil
drinks.instructions: Cut the half lime in half again. Add the lime, falernum, and bitters to a rocks glass. Muddle. Add the rum. (Aged Barbados rum such as Plantation 5 Year is recommended). Add ice and stir. Float the blackstrap rum on top. Serve with a straw.

drinks.name: Corpse Reviver
drinks.instructions: Shake, strain, straight up, cocktail glass rinsed with absinthe

drinks.name: Corpse Reviver #2
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice. Shake well and strain in chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Cosmopolitan
drinks.instructions: Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well and strain into large cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Cream Soda
drinks.instructions: Pour the spiced rum into a highball glass with ice. Top with ginger ale.

drinks.name: Cuba Libre
drinks.instructions: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.

drinks.name: Cynar Spritz
drinks.instructions: Build over ice in a wine glass. Top with soda water and stir gently.

drinks.name: Daiquiri
drinks.instructions: In a cocktail shaker add all ingredients. Stir well to dissolve the sugar. Add ice and shake. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Dark and Stormy
drinks.instructions: Build into highball glass filled with ice. Add rum first and top it with ginger beer.

drinks.name: Dark Caipirinha
drinks.instructions:
Muddle the sugar into the lime wedges in an old-fashioned glass.
Fill the glass with ice cubes.
Pour the cachaca into the glass.
Stir well.

drinks.name: Dark ‘N’ Stormy
drinks.instructions: In a highball glass filled with ice pour the ginger beer and top floating with the Rum.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with a lime wedge or slice.

drinks.name: Death in the Afternoon
drinks.instructions: Easy as you like, pour the absinthe into a chilled glass, top with champagne. Must be drunk mid afternoon for the optimum effect.

drinks.name: Derby
drinks.instructions: Stir in mixing glass with ice cubes. Strain into a cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Dirty Martini
drinks.instructions: Stir in mixing glass with ice cubes. Strain into chilled martini glass.

drinks.name: Division Bell
drinks.instructions: Combine all ingredients in a shaker with ice. Shake until chilled, strain into a coupe.

drinks.name: Don’s Special Daiquiri
drinks.instructions: Blend for a few seconds in a milkshake mixer with  crushed ice and pour into a footed copo glass. Fill the glass with more crushed ice.

drinks.name: Dragonfly
drinks.instructions: In a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes, combine the gin and ginger ale. Stir well. Garnish with the lime wedge.

drinks.name: Dry Martini
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain into chilled martini cocktail glass.
drinks.garnish: Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink, or garnish with a green olives if requested.

drinks.name: Dry Rob Roy
drinks.instructions: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the Scotch and vermouth. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with the lemon twist.

drinks.name: Dubonnet Cocktail
drinks.instructions: Stir all ingredients (except lemon peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.

drinks.name: Duchamp's Punch
drinks.instructions:
Shake all ingredients.
Double strain in a chilled double old fashioned glass with a big ice cube.
Garnish with a couple of lavender sprigs.

drinks.name: Eggnog
drinks.instructions: Pour spirit into a mug. Top with prepared eggnog. Stir to combine.

drinks.name: Elderflower Caipirinha
drinks.instructions: Take the glass and muddle the lime in it. Fill the glass with crushed ice and add the Cachaca. Stir well and top with some more crushed ice. Garnish with lime.

drinks.name: English Highball
drinks.instructions: Pour brandy, gin, and sweet vermouth into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water. Add the twist of lemon peel, stir, and serve.

drinks.name: English Rose Cocktail
drinks.instructions: Rub rim of cocktail glass with lemon juice and dip rim of glass in powdered sugar. Shake all ingredients (except cherry) with ice and strain into sugar-rimmed glass. Top with the cherry and serve.

drinks.name: Espresso Martini
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Espresso Rumtini
drinks.instructions: Mix together in a cocktail glass. Garnish with some choclate powder and coffee beans

drinks.name: Fernandito
drinks.instructions: Pour the Fernet Branca into a double old fashioned glass with ice, fill the glass up with Cola. Gently stir.

drinks.name: Fish House Punch
drinks.instructions: Build all ingredients over ice in a rocks glass. Stir gently.

drinks.name: Flaming Lamborghini
drinks.instructions: Pour the Sambuca and Kahlua into the Cocktail Glass and give the drinker a straw. Pour the Baileys and Blue Curacao into two separate shot glasses either side of the cocktail glass. Set light the concoction in the cocktail glass and start to drink through the straw (this drink should be drunk in one), as the bottom of the glass is reached put out the fire by pouring the Baileys and Blue Curacao into the cocktail glass and keep drinking till it's all gone.

drinks.name: Flying Dutchman
drinks.instructions: In an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes, combine the gin and triple sec. Stir well.

drinks.name: Flying Scotchman
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Foxy Lady
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a chilled cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: French 75
drinks.instructions: Pour all the ingredients, except Champagne, into a shaker. Shake well and strain into a Champagne flute. Top up with Champagne. Stir gently.

drinks.name: French Connection
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients directly into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently.

drinks.name: French Martini
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.garnish: Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink.

drinks.name: French Negroni
drinks.instructions:
Add ice to a shaker and pour in all ingredients.
Using a bar spoon, stir 40 to 45 revolutions or until thoroughly chilled.
Strain into a martini glass or over ice into a rocks glass. Garnish with orange twist.

drinks.name: Frisco Sour
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except slices of lemon and lime) with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Decorate with the slices of lemon and lime and serve.

drinks.name: Frosé
drinks.instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth, about 30–60 seconds. Pour into chilled wine glasses and serve immediately.

drinks.name: Frozen Daiquiri
drinks.instructions: Combine all ingredients (except for the cherry) in an electric blender and blend at a low speed for five seconds, then blend at a high speed until firm. Pour contents into a champagne flute, top with the cherry, and serve.

drinks.name: Frozen Mint Daiquiri
drinks.instructions: Combine all ingredients with 1 cup of crushed ice in an electric blender. Blend at a low speed for a short length of time. Pour into an old-fashioned glass and serve.

drinks.name: Frozen Pineapple Daiquiri
drinks.instructions: Combine all ingredients with 1 cup of crushed ice in an electric blender. Blend at a low speed for a short length of time. Pour into a cocktail glass and serve.

drinks.name: Funk and Soul
drinks.instructions: Mix all ingredients together and strain into a Collins glass. Use Jamaican rum where possible for a more authentic taste.

drinks.name: Gagliardo
drinks.instructions: Shake well and serve in a cocktail glass. This is a home cocktail of American/Internet Bar del Pozzo, Pavia, Italy.

drinks.name: Garibaldi
drinks.instructions: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.

drinks.name: GG
drinks.instructions: Pour the Galliano liqueur over ice. Fill the remainder of the glass with ginger ale and thats all there is to it. You now have a your very own GG.

drinks.name: Gibson
drinks.instructions: Stir gin and dry vermouth in a mixing glass with ice. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Gimlet
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Gin and Soda
drinks.instructions:
Pour the Gin and Soda water into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes.
Stir well.
Garnish with the lime wedge.

drinks.name: Gin Balalajka
drinks.instructions: Mix the gin and juice over ice and fill up with Schweppes Russchian. The gin and juice may be shaken for better taste.

drinks.name: Gin Basil Smash
drinks.instructions: Add all ingredients into shaker with ice. Shake vigorously and pour into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Gin Cooler
drinks.instructions: Stir the powdered sugar with a splash of soda water in a Collins glass until dissolved. Fill with ice and add gin, then top with soda water and stir.

drinks.name: Gin Daisy
drinks.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, lemon juice, sugar, and grenadine. Shake well. Pour into an old-fashioned glass and garnish with the cherry and the orange slice.

drinks.name: Gin Fizz
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice except soda water. Pour into thin tall Tumbler glass , top with a splash soda water.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with lemon slice, optional lemon zest.

drinks.name: Gin Lemon
drinks.instructions: For the preparation of the gin lemon you will not need the shaker. Fill the tumbler with ice, pour the gin and lemonade over it. Gently mix and decorate with a slice of lemon. Those who prefer can also add a few mint leaves. Your gin lemon is ready to be served.

drinks.name: Gin Rickey
drinks.instructions: Half-fill a tall glass with ice. Mix the gin and Grenadine together and pour over the ice. Add the lime or lemon juice and top off with soda water. Decorate the glass with lime and/or lemon slices.

drinks.name: Gin Sling
drinks.instructions: Dissolve powdered sugar in mixture of water and juice of lemon. Add gin. Pour into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes and stir. Add the twist of orange peel and serve.

drinks.name: Gin Smash
drinks.instructions: Muddle sugar with carbonated water and mint sprigs in an old-fashioned glass. Add gin and 1 ice cube. Stir, add the orange slice and the cherry, and serve.

drinks.name: Gin Sour
drinks.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, lemon juice, and sugar. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the orange slice and the cherry.

drinks.name: Gin Squirt
drinks.instructions: Stir gin, grenadine, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water and stir. Decorate with the pineapple chunks and the strawberries and serve.

drinks.name: Gin Swizzle
drinks.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the lime juice, sugar, gin, and bitters. Shake well. Almost fill a colling glass with ice cubes. Stir until the glass is frosted. Strain the mixture in the shaker into the glass and add the club soda.

drinks.name: Gin Toddy
drinks.instructions: Mix powdered sugar and water in an old-fashioned glass. Add gin and one ice cube. Stir, add the twist of lemon peel, and serve.

drinks.name: Gin & Tonic
drinks.instructions: Fill a highball glass with ice, pour the gin, top with tonic water and squeeze a lemon wedge and garnish with a lemon wedge.

drinks.name: God Father
drinks.instructions: Build into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently.

drinks.name: God Mother
drinks.instructions: Build into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently.

drinks.name: Godchild
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients well with cracked ice, strain into a champagne flute, and serve.

drinks.name: Godfather
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients directly into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently.

drinks.name: Godmother
drinks.instructions: Pour vodka and amaretto into an old-fashioned glass over ice and serve.

drinks.name: Gold Rush
drinks.instructions: Combine all ingredients in a shaker with ice. Shake well, strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.

drinks.name: Golden Cadillac
drinks.instructions: Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice, shake until chilled, strain into a chilled coupe.

drinks.name: Golden Dream
drinks.instructions: Shake with ice cubes. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Grand Blue
drinks.instructions: Serve in an old fashioned glass.

drinks.name: Grand Margarita
drinks.instructions: Rim the rock glass with good quality sea salt. Pour the ingredients into the  shaker. Add ice to both glass and shaker. Shake hard for 10 seconds. Strain the drink into the glass.

drinks.name: Grass Skirt
drinks.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, triple sec, pineapple juice, and grenadine. Shake well. Pour into an old-fashioned glass and garnish with the pineapple slice.

drinks.name: Grasshopper
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into shaker filled with ice. Shake briskly for a few seconds. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Greyhound
drinks.instructions:
Add the vodka to a Collins glass filled with ice.
Top with grapefruit juice and stir.

drinks.name: Grim Reaper
drinks.instructions: Mix Kahlua and 151 in glass. Quickly add ice and pour grenadine over ice to give ice red tint.

drinks.name: Hanky Panky
drinks.instructions: Stir all ingredients in a mixing glass with ice until well chilled. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Happy Skipper
drinks.instructions: Pour Captain Morgan's Spiced Rum over ice, fill glass to top with Ginger Ale. Garnish with lime. Tastes like a cream soda. Named for the Gilligan's Island reference ("The Captain" *in* "Ginger" is a Happy Skipper!)

drinks.name: Harvey Wallbanger
drinks.instructions: Build vodka and orange juice into a highball glass filled with ice. Stir gently and float Galliano on top.

drinks.name: Havana Cocktail
drinks.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Hawaiian Cocktail
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Hemingway Daiquiri
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice. Shake well and strain into a large cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Highland Fling Cocktail
drinks.instructions: Stir all ingredients (except olive) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the olive and serve.

drinks.name: Honey Bee
drinks.instructions: Shake ingredients with crushed ice

drinks.name: Horse's Neck
drinks.instructions: Pour Cognac and ginger ale directly into highball glass with ice cubes. Stir gently. If preferred, add dashes of Angostura Bitter.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with rind of one lemon spiral.

drinks.name: Hot Toddy
drinks.instructions: Warm a heatproof mug. Add the whiskey, honey and lemon juice, then top with hot water and stir until the honey dissolves.

drinks.name: Hugo Spritz
drinks.instructions: Add mint and lime to a wine glass with ice. Pour in prosecco and elderflower syrup, top with soda water and stir gently.

drinks.name: Hurricane
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice. Pour into a hurricane glass over fresh ice.

drinks.name: IBA Tiki
drinks.instructions: In a cocktail shaker muddle a thin slice of Gengibre, Pour all other ingredients. Shake vigorously with ice. Strain into a chilled Tiki glass filled with pebbled ice.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with citruses and dehydrated pineapple slice.

drinks.name: Ice Pick
drinks.instructions: Put Vodka in glass fill with iced tea. Stir in lemon to taste.

drinks.name: Illegal
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into the shaker. Shake vigorously with ice. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass, or “on the rocks” in a traditional clay or terracotta mug.

drinks.name: Imperial Cocktail
drinks.instructions: Shake with ice and strain into cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Imperial Fizz
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

drinks.name: Ipamena
drinks.instructions: Cut half a lime into pieces, place in a shaker, add the sugar and crush. Measure the passion fruit juice, add it to the shaker and fill up with ice cubes. Close the shaker and shake vigorously. Pour the liquid into a glass, top up with ginger ale, stir with a teaspoon and then garnish the rim of the glass with a slice of lime

drinks.name: Irish Coffee
drinks.instructions: Warm black coffee is poured into a preheated Irish coffee glass. Whiskey and at least one teaspoon of sugar is added and stirred until dissolved. Fresh thick chilled cream is carefully poured over the back of a spoon held just above the surface of the coffee. The layer of cream will float on the coffee without mixing. Plain sugar can be replaced with sugar syrup

drinks.name: Irish Curdling Cow
drinks.instructions: Pour Irish Cream, Vodka, and Bourbon in a glass. Add some ice and mix in the orange juice.

drinks.name: Irish Spring
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients (except orange slice and cherry) into a collins glass over ice cubes. Garnish with the slice of orange, add the cherry on top, and serve.

drinks.name: Jack Rose Cocktail
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Japanese Fizz
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

drinks.name: Jewel Of The Nile
drinks.instructions: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Jitterbug
drinks.instructions: Wet glass, dip rim in sugar. Then add Ice. Then add everything else. It's that simple!

drinks.name: John Collins
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients directly into highball filled with ice. Stir gently.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with lemon slice and maraschino cherry.

drinks.name: Jungle Bird
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice and shake. Strain into a rocks glass filled with ice.

drinks.name: Kamikaze
drinks.instructions: Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Karsk
drinks.instructions: Put a copper coin in a coffe-cup and fill up with coffee until you no longer see the coin, then add alcohol until you see the coin. Norwegian speciality.

drinks.name: Kentucky B And B
drinks.instructions: Pour the bourbon and Benedictine into a brandy snifter.

drinks.name: Kentucky Colonel
drinks.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes combine the courbon and Benedictine. Shake and strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with the lemon twist.

drinks.name: Kir
drinks.instructions: Pour Crème de Cassis into glass, top up with white wine.

drinks.name: Kir Royale
drinks.instructions: Pour Creme de cassis in glass, gently pour champagne on top

drinks.name: Kiwi Lemon
drinks.instructions: Mix in highball glass. Stirr. Garnish with slice of kiwi.

drinks.name: Kiwi Martini
drinks.instructions: Peel the kiwi and muddle gently with the simple syrup in a shaker. Add vodka and ice, shake until well chilled, then fine-strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Lady Love Fizz
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

drinks.name: Last Word
drinks.instructions: Add all ingredients into a cocktail shaker. Shake with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Lazy Coconut Paloma
drinks.instructions: Add coconut liqueur and grapefruit juice to a highball glass filled with ice. Top with soda water and stir gently.
drinks.garnish: Large grapefruit slice against the inside of the glass

drinks.name: Lemon Drop
drinks.instructions: Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass rimmed with sugar.

drinks.name: Lemon Drop Martini
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice. Shake well and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Lemon Elderflower Spritzer
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients over ice, stir.

drinks.name: Loch Lomond
drinks.instructions: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the Scotch, Drambuie, and vermouth. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with the lemon twist.

drinks.name: London Town
drinks.instructions: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Lone Tree Cocktail
drinks.instructions: Stir ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Lone Tree Cooler
drinks.instructions: Stir the powdered sugar with a splash of soda water in a Collins glass until dissolved. Fill with ice, add gin and vermouth, then top with soda water and stir.

drinks.name: Long Island Iced Tea
drinks.instructions: Add all ingredients into highball glass filled with ice. Stir gently.

drinks.name: Long Island Tea
drinks.instructions: Combine all ingredients (except cola) and pour over ice in a highball glass. Add the splash of cola for color. Decorate with a slice of lemon and serve.

drinks.name: Long vodka
drinks.instructions: Shake a tall glass with ice cubes and Angostura, coating the inside of the glass. Por the vodka onto this, add 1 slice of lime and squeeze juice out of remainder, mix with tonic, stir and voila you have a Long Vodka

drinks.name: Lord And Lady
drinks.instructions: Pour the rum and Tia Maria into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.

drinks.name: Mai Tai
drinks.instructions: Add all ingredients into a shaker with ice. Shake and pour into a double rocks glass or an highball glass. * The Martinique molasses rum used by Trader Vic was not an Agricole Rhum but a type of “rummy” from molasses.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with pineapple spear, mint leaves and lime peel.

drinks.name: Mango Mojito
drinks.instructions: Muddle the mint leaves with the sugar and lime juice in a highball glass. Add the rum and mango purée, fill with crushed ice, then top with soda water and stir gently.

drinks.name: Manhattan
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Margarita
drinks.instructions: Add all ingredients into a shaker with ice. Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Martinez
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Martini
drinks.instructions: Straight: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain in chilled martini cocktail glass. Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink, or garnish with olive.

drinks.name: Mary Pickford
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Mauresque
drinks.instructions:
1 - Pour the Ricard (or pastis)
2 - Pour the orgeat syrup
3 - Finally pour the water and add ice cubes at your convenience.

Add the ice cubes at the end, otherwise the syrup and pastis do not mix well.

drinks.name: Mezcal Negroni
drinks.instructions: Build over ice in a rocks glass. Stir gently.

drinks.name: Miami Vice
drinks.instructions: Blend half the rum with piña colada mix and ice; set aside. Blend the remaining rum with daiquiri mix and ice. Layer the two halves in a hurricane glass without mixing them.

drinks.name: Michelada
drinks.instructions:
Mix the beer with tomato juice, freshly squeezed lime juice, and Worcestershire sauce, teriyaki sauce, soy sauce, or hot sauce.
Served In a chilled, salt-rimmed glass

drinks.name: Midnight Mint
drinks.instructions: If available, rim cocktail (Martini) glass with sugar syrup then dip into chocolate flakes or powder. Add ingredients into shaker with ice. Shake well then strain into cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Mimosa
drinks.instructions: Pour orange juice into flute glass and gently pour the sparkling wine. Stir gently.

drinks.name: Mint Julep
drinks.instructions: In Julep Stainless Steel Cup gently muddle the mint with sugar and water. Fill the glass with cracked ice, add the Bourbon and stir well until the cup frosts.

drinks.name: Missionary’s Downfall
drinks.instructions: Blend all the ingredients with half cup of crushed ice. Serve it in a Coppa grande.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with mint sprig and a slice of pineapple.

drinks.name: Mojito
drinks.instructions: Mix mint sprigs with sugar and lime juice. Add splash of soda water and fill the glass with ice. Pour the rum and top with soda water. Light stir to involve all ingredients.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with sprigs of mint and slice of lime.

drinks.name: Mojito Extra
drinks.instructions: Put mint with lemon juice in a glas, mash the mint with a spoon, ice, rum & fill up with club soda. Top it with Angostura.

drinks.name: Monkey Gland
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Monkey Wrench
drinks.instructions: Pour all of the ingredients into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.

drinks.name: Moscow Mule
drinks.instructions: In an Mule Cup or rocks glass, combine the vodka and ginger beer. Add lime juice and gently stir to involve all ingredients.

drinks.name: Mudslide
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice. Strain into a hurricane glass over fresh ice.

drinks.name: Munich Mule
drinks.instructions:
Fill glass with ice.
Pour Gin and Lime Juice.
Fill glass with Ginger Beer.
Garnish with Cucumber and Lime slice.

drinks.name: Naked and Famous
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: National Aquarium
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a shaker of ice. Shake well. Serve on the rocks.

drinks.name: Negroni
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients directly into chilled old fashioned glass filled with ice. Stir gently.

drinks.name: Negroni Sbagliato
drinks.instructions: Build all ingredients over ice in a rocks glass. Stir gently.

drinks.name: New York Lemonade
drinks.instructions: Serve in a chilled cocktail glass. Lemon and sugar the rim. Stir and Strain.

drinks.name: New York Sour
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into the shaker. Shake vigorously with ice. Strain into a chilled rocks glass filled with ice. Float the wine on top.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with lemon or orange zest with cherry.

drinks.name: Oaxacan Old Fashioned
drinks.instructions: Combine all ingredients in an Old Fashioned glass with one large ice cube. Stir until chilled.

ingredients.note: Del Maguey San Luis Del Rio preferred

drinks.name: Old Cuban
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker except the wine, shake well with ice, strain into chilled elegant cocktail glass. Top up with the sparkling wine.

drinks.name: Old Fashioned
drinks.instructions: Place sugar cube in old fashioned glass and saturate with bitter, add few dashes of plain water. Muddle until dissolved. Fill the glass with ice cubes and add whiskey. Stir gently.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with orange slice or zest, and a cocktail cherry.

drinks.name: Old Pal
drinks.instructions: Chill cocktail glass. Add ingredients to a mixing glass, and fill 2/3 full with ice. Stir about 20 seconds. Empty cocktail glass and strain into the glass. Garnish with a twist of lemon peel.

drinks.name: Orange Oasis
drinks.instructions: Shake brandy, gin, and orange juice with ice and strain into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with ginger ale, stir, and serve.

drinks.name: Orange Rosemary Collins
drinks.instructions: Add the spirits to the bottom of the glass and top equally with the mixer drinks. Garnish with orange slices inside the glass as well as some rosemary on top.

drinks.name: Orangeade
drinks.instructions: Place some ice cubes in a large tumbler or highball glass, add lemon juice, orange juice, sugar syrup, and stir well. Top up with cold soda water, serve with a drinking straw.

drinks.name: Oreo Mudslide
drinks.instructions: Blend Vodka, Kahlua, Bailey's, ice-cream and the Oreo well in a blender. Pour into a large frosted glass. Garnish with whipped cream and a cherry.

drinks.name: Orgasm
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a chilled cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Owen's Grandmother's Revenge
drinks.instructions: Add ingredients and mix in blender.

drinks.name: Painkiller
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice. Pour into a hurricane glass over fresh ice.
drinks.garnish: Generous amount of fresh grated nutmeg on top

drinks.name: Paloma
drinks.instructions: Poor the tequila into a highball glass, squeeze the lime juice. Add ice and salt, fill up pink grapefruit soda. Stir gently.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with a slice of lime.

drinks.name: Paper Plane
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Paradise
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Passion Fruit Martini
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a glass and stir. Garnish with half a passion fruit piece.

drinks.name: Pegu Club
drinks.instructions: Shake, strain, up, cocktail glass

drinks.name: Penicillin
drinks.instructions: Muddle fresh ginger in a shaker and add the remaining ingredients except for the Islay single malt whisky. Fill the shaker with ice and shake. Fine train into a chilled Old Fashioned glass with ice. Float the single malt whisky on top.

drinks.name: Pimm's Cup
drinks.instructions: Build Pimm's over ice in a highball glass. Top with lemonade. Add cucumber, citrus and strawberry; stir gently.

drinks.name: Piña Colada
drinks.instructions: Blend all ingredients with crushed ice in a blender until smooth. Pour into a hurricane glass.

drinks.name: Pineapple Paloma
drinks.instructions:
Rub the rim of each glass with lime slice and dip into salt.
Add ice, tequila, grapefruit juice, lime juice and top with pineapple soda.
Give it a quick stir.
Garnish with fresh pineapple or lime.

drinks.name: Pink Gin
drinks.instructions: Pour the bitters into a wine glass. Swirl the glass to coat the inside with the bitters, shake out the excess. Pour the gin into the glass. Do not add ice.

drinks.name: Pink Lady
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Pink Moon
drinks.instructions: Slowly shake in a shaker with ice, strain into a square whiskey glass. Top with fresh ice. Add the blackberries to garnish. Add flowers and a green leaf for a special look!

drinks.name: Pink Squirrel
drinks.instructions: Shake with ice, strain into a cocktail glass and serve.

drinks.name: Pisco Punch
drinks.instructions: Gentle mash the simple syrup with the cloves, add the remaining ingredients except the wine. Shake vigorously and double strain into a large goblet. Add the wine on top and gently stir.

drinks.name: Pisco Sour
drinks.instructions: Add all ingredients into a shaker with ice. Shake and strain into a chilled goblet glass.
drinks.garnish: Few dashes of Amargo bitters on top as an aromatic garnish.

drinks.name: Planter's Punch
drinks.instructions: Build all ingredients in a highball glass over ice. Stir gently.

drinks.name: Planters Punch
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients directly in a small tumbler or a typical terracotta glass.

drinks.name: Popped cherry
drinks.instructions: Served over ice in a tall glass with a popped cherry (can add more popped cherries if in the mood)!

drinks.name: Poppy Cocktail
drinks.instructions: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Porn Star Martini
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, double strain into a large chilled cocktail glass. Accompany with a shot of champagne.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with passion fruit cup and sugar.

drinks.name: Pornstar Martini
drinks.instructions: Straight: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain in chilled martini cocktail glass. Cut passion fruit in half and use as garnish. Pour prosecco into a chilled shot glass and serve alongside the martini.

drinks.name: Port And Starboard
drinks.instructions: Pour carefully into a pousse-cafe glass, so that creme de menthe floats on grenadine. Serve without mixing.

drinks.name: Port Wine Cocktail
drinks.instructions: Stir ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Port Wine Flip
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

drinks.name: Porto Flip
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Pure Passion
drinks.instructions: Mix up all ingredients with a cocktail stirrer and serve with crushed ice with mint and edible flour if available.

drinks.name: Quaker's Cocktail
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Quarter Deck Cocktail
drinks.instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Queen Bee
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Queen Charlotte
drinks.instructions: Pour red wine and grenadine into a collins glass over ice cubes. Fill with lemon-lime soda, stir, and serve.

drinks.name: Queen Elizabeth
drinks.instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Quentin
drinks.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, Kahlua, and cream. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the nutmeg.

drinks.name: Rabo de Galo
drinks.instructions: Combine all the ingredients into a rocks glass, add ice and stir briefly.

drinks.name: Radioactive Long Island Iced Tea
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients over ice in a very tall glass. Sip cautiously.

drinks.name: Radler
drinks.instructions: Pour beer into large mug, slowly add the 7-up (or Sprite).

drinks.name: Rail Splitter
drinks.instructions: Mix sugar syrup with lemon juice in a tall glass. Fill up with ginger ale.

drinks.name: Ramos Fizz
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients except soda water in a cocktail shaker with ice. Shake for two minutes, double strain in a glass, pour the drink back in the shaker and hard shake without ice for one minute. Strain into a highball glass, top up with soda.

drinks.name: Raspberry Julep
drinks.instructions: Softly muddle the mint leaves and raspberry syrup in the bottom of the cup. Add crushed ice and Bourbon to the cup and then stir. Top with more ice, garnish with a mint sprig.

drinks.name: Remember the Maine
drinks.instructions: Pour the absinthe into a coupe glass and swirl to completely coat the inside. Discard the absinthe and set the glass aside. Add the other ingredients to a mixing glass and fill it 3/4 full with ice. Stir until chilled, then strain into the glass rinsed with the absinthe.

drinks.name: Rose
drinks.instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice and strain into a cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Royal Fizz
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except cola) with ice and strain into a chilled collins glass. Fill with cola and serve.

drinks.name: Royal Gin Fizz
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

drinks.name: Ruby Tuesday
drinks.instructions: Pour gin and cranberry into a highball filled with ice cubes. Add grenadine and stir.

drinks.name: Rum Cobbler
drinks.instructions: In an old-fashioned glass, dissolve the sugar in the club soda. Add crushed ice until the glass is almost full. Add the rum. Stir well. Garnish with the cherry and the orange and lemon slices.

drinks.name: Rum Cooler
drinks.instructions: Pour the rum and soda into a collins glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well and garnish with the lemon wedge.

drinks.name: Rum Milk Punch
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain into a collins glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

drinks.name: Rum Old-fashioned
drinks.instructions: Stir powdered sugar, water, and bitters in an old-fashioned glass. When sugar has dissolved add ice cubes and light rum. Add the twist of lime peel, float 151 proof rum on top, and serve.

drinks.name: Rum Screwdriver
drinks.instructions: Pour rum into a highball glass over ice cubes. Add orange juice, stir, and serve.

drinks.name: Rum Sour
drinks.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, lemon juice, and sugar. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the orange slice and the cherry.

drinks.name: Rum Toddy
drinks.instructions: Dissolve powdered sugar in water in an old-fashioned glass. Add rum and one ice cube and stir. Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.

drinks.name: Russian Spring Punch
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker except the sparkling wine, shake well with ice, strain into chilled tall tumbler glass filled with ice and top up with sparkling wine.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with blackberries and optionally a lemon slice as well.

drinks.name: Rusty Nail
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients directly into an old fashioned glass filled with ice. Stir gently.

drinks.name: Salty Dog
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients over ice cubes in a highball glass. Stir well and serve.

drinks.name: San Francisco
drinks.instructions: Take a tall glass and put in a few ice cubes, fill the vodka over it and fill with juice then the "creme", to end fill in the grenadine but very carefully at the side of the glass so it will lay down in the bottom. garnish with orange and strawberry.

drinks.name: Sazerac
drinks.instructions: Rinse a chilled old fashioned glass with absinthe, then discard. In a mixing glass, muddle the sugar cube with Peychaud's bitters. Add cognac and ice; stir well until chilled. Strain into the absinthe-rinsed glass.

ingredients.note: to rinse the glass — discard excess

drinks.name: Scooter
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients well with cracked ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Scotch Sour
drinks.instructions: Shake scotch, juice of lime, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Decorate with 1/2 slice lemon, top with the cherry, and serve.

drinks.name: Screwdriver
drinks.instructions: Build into a highball glass filled with ice. Stir gently.

drinks.name: Sea Breeze
drinks.instructions: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with an orange zest and cherry.

drinks.name: Seelbach
drinks.instructions: Stir bourbon, Cointreau and both bitters in a mixing glass with ice. Strain into a chilled champagne flute. Top with champagne.

drinks.name: Sex on the Beach
drinks.instructions: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.

drinks.name: Sherry Cobbler
drinks.instructions: Combine sherry, sugar and 2 quarter wheels each of orange and lemon in a shaker with ice, shake briskly, strain into a Julep cocktail cup filled with crushed ice.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with fresh berries, ¼ wheel each orange and lemon. Serve with straws.

drinks.name: Sherry Eggnog
drinks.instructions: Shake sherry, powdered sugar, and egg with ice and strain into a collins glass. Fill with milk and stir. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

drinks.name: Sherry Flip
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

drinks.name: Sidecar
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Singapore Sling
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain into Hurricane glass.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with pineapple and maraschino cherry.

drinks.name: Snowball
drinks.instructions: Place an ice cube in a highball glass and add the Advocaat. Top with lemonade and stir gently.

drinks.name: Snowday
drinks.instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice. Strain into a chilled rocks glass over fresh ice. Express orange peel over drink and garnish.

drinks.name: Sol Y Sombra
drinks.instructions: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a brandy snifter, and serve.

drinks.name: South Side
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, double-strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Southside
drinks.instructions: Lightly muddle mint with simple syrup in a shaker. Add remaining ingredients and ice, shake well. Double-strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Space Odyssey
drinks.instructions: Fill glass with ice and add shots of Bacardi and Malibu. Add splash of pineapple juice and top with orange juice. Add grenadine for color and garnish with cherries.

drinks.name: Spicy Fifty
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, double-strain into chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with a red chili pepper.

drinks.name: Stinger
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain into chilled martini cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Stone Sour
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a chilled whiskey sour glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Suffering Bastard
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker except the ginger beer, shake well with ice. Pour unstrained into a Collins glass or in the original. S. Bastard mug and top up with ginger beer.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with mint spring and optionally an orange slice as well.

drinks.name: Tequila Fizz
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except ginger ale) with ice and strain into a collins glass over ice cubes. Fill with ginger ale, stir, and serve.

drinks.name: Tequila Sour
drinks.instructions: Shake tequila, juice of lemon, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Add the half-slice of lemon, top with the cherry, and serve.

drinks.name: Tequila Sunrise
drinks.instructions: Pour tequila and orange juice directly into highball glass filled with ice cubes. Add the grenadine syrup to create chromatic effect (sunrise), do not stir.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with half orange slice or an orange zest.

drinks.name: The Galah
drinks.instructions: Mix together the alcoholic portions and top with Pineapple and Lime juice.

drinks.name: The Jimmy Conway
drinks.instructions:
Fill glass with ice
Pour in The Irishman and Disaronno
Fill to the top with Cranberry Juice
Garnish with a slice of lemon.

drinks.name: The Last Word
drinks.instructions: Shake with ice and strain into a cocktail glass.

drinks.name: The Philosopher
drinks.instructions: Add all the spirits in a shaker (best to use Hendricks gin) as well as the orange bitters and lemon juice. Strain into a Margarita glass, top with Prosecco.

drinks.name: Three Dots and a Dash
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients in a Blender with 12 ounces of crushed ice, flash blend, pour the drink into a footed copo glass. Fill the glass with more crushed ice.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with three cherries and a rectangular chunk of pineapple.

drinks.name: Thriller
drinks.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Tipperary
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain into chilled martini cocktail glass.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with a slice of orange.

drinks.name: Tom Collins
drinks.instructions: Mix the gin, lemon juice and simple syrup in a tall glass with ice. Top with soda water and stir gently.

drinks.name: Tommy's Margarita
drinks.instructions: Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Tommy’s Margarita
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled rocks glass filled with ice.

drinks.name: Toronto
drinks.instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Trinidad Sour
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker, shake well with ice. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Turf Cocktail
drinks.instructions: Stir all ingredients (except orange peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the twist of orange peel and serve.

drinks.name: Tuxedo
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain into chilled martini cocktail glass.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with cherry and lemon zest.

drinks.name: Valencia Cocktail
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Vampiro
drinks.instructions: Shake with ice cubes. Strain into a highball glass, filled with ice.
drinks.garnish: Lime wedge and a green or red chili

drinks.name: Van Vleet
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes, and serve.

drinks.name: Ve.N.To
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into the shaker. Shake vigorously with ice. Strain into a chilled small tumbler glass filled with ice.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with lemon zest and white grapes.

drinks.name: Vermouth Cassis
drinks.instructions: Stir vermouth and creme de cassis in a highball glass with ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir again, and serve.

drinks.name: Vesper
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes. Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Vesuvio
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes, and serve.

drinks.name: Veteran
drinks.instructions: Pour the rum and cherry brandy into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.

drinks.name: Victor
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Victory Collins
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except orange slice) with ice and strain into a collins glass over ice cubes. Add the slice of orange and serve.

drinks.name: Vieux Carré
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.
drinks.garnish: Garnish with orange zest and maraschino cherry.

drinks.name: Vodka And Tonic
drinks.instructions: Pour vodka into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with tonic water, stir, and serve.

drinks.name: Vodka Lemon
drinks.instructions: The vodka lemon is prepared directly in a highball glass or in a large tumbler: put 6-7 ice cubes in the glass, pour the vodka, lemonade and mix with a bar spoon. Finally decorate with a slice of lemon and, if you prefer, add a few mint leaves. Your vodka lemon is ready to be served.

drinks.name: Vodka Martini
drinks.instructions: Shake the vodka and vermouth together with a number of ice cubes, strain into a cocktail glass, add the olive and serve.

drinks.name: Vodka Slime
drinks.instructions: Fill glass with ice. Add vodka, 7-up then finish with the lime juice.

drinks.name: Vodka Tonic
drinks.instructions: Fill a highball glass with ice. Pour in the vodka, then top with tonic water. Squeeze a lime wedge into the glass and stir gently.

drinks.name: Waikiki Beachcomber
drinks.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

drinks.name: Whiskey Highball
drinks.instructions: Fill a highball glass with ice. Add whiskey, top with chilled soda water, stir once to combine.

drinks.name: Whiskey Sour
drinks.instructions: Dry shake all ingredients without ice to emulsify the egg white. Add ice and shake again until well chilled. Strain into a chilled rocks glass.
drinks.garnish: Half orange slice and cocktail cherry

drinks.name: Whisky Mac
drinks.instructions: Pour both of the ingredients into a wine goblet with no ice.

drinks.name: White Lady
drinks.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: White Negroni
drinks.instructions: Build over ice in a rocks glass. Stir gently.

drinks.name: White Russian
drinks.instructions: Pour vodka and coffee liqueur over ice cubes in an old-fashioned glass. Fill with light cream and serve.

drinks.name: Yellow Bird
drinks.instructions: Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

drinks.name: Ziemes Martini Apfelsaft
drinks.instructions: Serve without ice. At least the juice shold have room temperature.

drinks.name: Zima Blaster
drinks.instructions: Fill glass with ice. Pour in Chambord, then fill with Zima. Mix and enjoy.

drinks.name: Zippy's Revenge
drinks.instructions: Mix Kool-Aid to taste then add Rum and ammaretto. shake well to disolve the sugar in the Kool-Aid... serve cold

drinks.name: Zombie
drinks.instructions: Add all ingredients into an electric blender with 170 grams of cracked ice. With pulse bottom blend for a few seconds. Serve in a tall tumbler glass.

drinks.name: Zorbatini
drinks.instructions: Stir vodka and ouzo with ice in a mixing glass until well chilled, then strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
